engine.label: built in
engine.title: Virtual Analog
engine.summary: virtual analog: saw/pulse/sub oscillators, sync, ladder-style filter, envelopes (8 presets)

params.name: gain
params.label: Level
params.hover: The overall loudness of the sound. Range 0.5 to 5.

params.name: pres_lin
params.label: Dynamics (even)
params.hover: The even part of how pressure becomes loudness: more here and a light touch already speaks. Range 0 to 1.

params.name: pres_sq
params.label: Dynamics (curved)
params.hover: The curved part of how pressure becomes loudness: more here and the loud end opens up faster than the soft end. Range 0 to 1.5.

params.name: pres_hz
params.label: Response
params.hover: How quickly the sound follows a change of pressure: low is a slow swell, high is immediate. Range 1 to 200 Hz.

params.name: hold_decay
params.label: Fall while held
params.hover: The fastest the level can fall while the key stays down, so a quick lift still leaves a tail. Range 0.005 to 1 s.

params.name: release
params.label: Release
params.hover: How long the sound takes to die away after the key is released. Range 0.02 to 4 s.

params.name: rel_pedal
params.label: Release with pedal
params.hover: How much longer the release gets with the sustain pedal down. Range 0 to 6 s.

params.name: rel_speed
params.label: Release by lift speed
params.hover: How much a quick lift-off shortens the tail: 0 no effect, higher cuts it short. Range 0 to 8.

params.name: acc_level
params.label: Accent
params.hover: The extra push at the start of a struck note: 0 none, higher is a sharper attack. Range 0 to 2.5.

params.name: acc_decay
params.label: Accent length
params.hover: How long the accent lasts before the note settles. Range 0.005 to 0.4 s.

params.name: acc_key
params.label: Accent by register
params.hover: How much longer the accent lasts on low notes than on high ones. Range 0 to 0.06.

params.name: acc_cutoff
params.label: Accent cutoff
params.hover: How far the filter opens at a strike, in semitones. Range 0 to 48 semitones.

params.name: acc_drive
params.label: Accent drive
params.hover: The extra saturation at a strike. Range 0 to 2.

params.name: acc_sync
params.label: Accent sync
params.hover: The extra sync sweep at a strike, in semitones, when timbre is up. Range 0 to 24 semitones.

params.name: acc_pitch
params.label: Accent pitch
params.hover: A pitch offset at the strike that fades with the accent: below 0 the note scoops up, above 0 it drops in. Range -1 to 1 semitones.

params.name: cut_base
params.label: Cutoff
params.hover: Where the filter sits when closed, as a note number. Range -20 to 80 note.

params.name: cut_key
params.label: Cutoff tracking
params.hover: How much the cutoff follows the note: 1 keeps the tone the same up the keyboard. Range 0 to 1.2.

params.name: cut_env
params.label: Cutoff by pressure
params.hover: How far pressure opens the filter. Range 0 to 80 semitones.

params.name: cut_back
params.label: Cutoff, timbre down
params.hover: How far the filter closes with timbre down. Range -24 to 24 semitones.

params.name: cut_fwd
params.label: Cutoff, timbre up
params.hover: How far the filter opens with timbre up. Range -24 to 24 semitones.

params.name: res
params.label: Resonance
params.hover: The filter's resonance: near 0.98 it rings on its own. Range 0 to 0.98.

params.name: res_back
params.label: Resonance, timbre down
params.hover: How much timbre down adds to the resonance. Range -0.5 to 0.98.

params.name: res_fwd
params.label: Resonance, timbre up
params.hover: How much timbre up takes from the resonance. Range -0.5 to 0.98.

params.name: bass_comp
params.label: Bass compensation
params.hover: How much the bass is brought back as the resonance rises. Range 0 to 1.

params.name: drive
params.label: Drive
params.hover: The saturation after the filter. Range 0.1 to 3.

params.name: drive_env
params.label: Drive by pressure
params.hover: How much more saturation pressure adds. Range 0 to 3.

params.name: saw
params.label: Saw
params.hover: The level of the main sawtooth. Range 0 to 1.

params.name: saw_back
params.label: Saw, timbre down
params.hover: How much timbre down reduces the saw. Range 0 to 1.

params.name: saw_fwd
params.label: Saw, timbre up
params.hover: How much timbre up reduces the saw. Range 0 to 1.

params.name: saw2
params.label: Second saw
params.hover: The level of the detuned second sawtooth. Range 0 to 1.

params.name: saw2_back
params.label: Second saw, timbre down
params.hover: How much timbre down reduces the second saw. Range 0 to 1.

params.name: saw2_fwd
params.label: Second saw, timbre up
params.hover: How much timbre up reduces the second saw. Range 0 to 1.

params.name: saw2_detune
params.label: Second saw detune
params.hover: How far the second saw is detuned. Range -0.5 to 0.5 semitones.

params.name: pulse
params.label: Pulse
params.hover: The level of the pulse wave. Range 0 to 1.

params.name: pulse_back
params.label: Pulse, timbre down
params.hover: How much timbre down adds pulse. Range 0 to 1.

params.name: pwm
params.label: Pulse width sweep
params.hover: How far the pulse width sweeps. Range 0 to 0.4.

params.name: pwm_hz
params.label: Pulse width rate
params.hover: How fast the pulse width sweeps. Range 0.05 to 8 Hz.

params.name: sub
params.label: Sub
params.hover: The level of the sub-oscillator an octave down. Range 0 to 1.

params.name: sub_base
params.label: Sub at rest
params.hover: How much of the sub sounds with the timbre at rest. Range 0 to 1.

params.name: sub_back
params.label: Sub, timbre down
params.hover: How much timbre down adds sub. Range 0 to 1.

params.name: sub_fwd
params.label: Sub, timbre up
params.hover: How much timbre up takes from the sub. Range 0 to 1.

params.name: b_sync
params.label: B synced
params.hover: Whether the second oscillator is hard-synced to the first (on) or runs free and detuned (off). Range off or on.

params.name: b_level
params.label: B level
params.hover: The level of the second oscillator. Range 0 to 1.

params.name: b_fwd
params.label: B, timbre up
params.hover: How much timbre up adds of the second oscillator. Range 0 to 1.

params.name: b_detune
params.label: B detune
params.hover: How far down the second oscillator is detuned when it runs free. Range -0.5 to 0.5 semitones.

params.name: sync
params.label: Sync ratio
params.hover: How far above the note the synced oscillator runs, with timbre up. Range 0 to 24 semitones.

params.name: sync_fwd
params.label: Sync, timbre up
params.hover: How much further timbre up sweeps the sync. Range 0 to 24 semitones.

params.name: sync_env
params.label: Sync by pressure
params.hover: How far pressure sweeps the sync. Range 0 to 24 semitones.

params.name: tilt_home
params.label: Timbre home
params.hover: Where the timbre sits while the timbre control is centred: below 0 down, above 0 up. Range -1 to 1.

params.name: drift
params.label: Pitch drift
params.hover: A slow wander of the main oscillator's pitch. Range 0 to 0.3 semitones.

params.name: saw2_drift
params.label: Second saw drift
params.hover: A slow wander of the second saw's pitch. Range 0 to 0.3 semitones.

params.name: cut_drift
params.label: Cutoff drift
params.hover: A slow wander of the filter cutoff. Range 0 to 2 semitones.

params.name: gyro_chorus
params.label: Chorus by rotation
params.hover: How much rotation (the motion input) detunes the second saw. Range 0 to 1.

params.name: vibrato
params.label: Vibrato by shake
params.hover: How much vibrato a shake (the motion input) adds, in semitones at a full shake. Range 0 to 1.5 semitones.

params.name: vib_hz
params.label: Vibrato rate
params.hover: How fast the vibrato wavers. Range 1 to 9 Hz.

params.name: life
params.label: Life
params.hover: Micro-randomness: 0 every note identical, 1 each one slightly different. Range 0 to 1.

params.name: output
params.label: Output
params.hover: The output level after the engine: at 1 the engine's own level, 0 silent. Range 0 to 2.
